skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the nature of customer relationships and the activities of customer relationship management; analyze and make decisions on the foundational factors for establishing, maintaining, and developing customer relationships; develop and implement CRM strategies.
Apply marketing knowledge to understand and manage customer relationships.
Propose strategies, solutions, and plans for customer relationship management.
Manage customer loyalty programs and campaigns.
Provide customer service and resolve customer conflicts.
Work independently and in teams to build and manage customer relationships.
Prepare and deliver group presentations on customer relationship management topics.
Analyze and evaluate customer relationship management activities.
Conduct data analysis in customer relationship management.
Manage projects related to customer relationship management.
